2105-3480-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3480-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3480-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

751-1115-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

261-413-1981.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
261-413-1981.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

323-1580-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-1580-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Falkenrath Noble and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3755-4770-4785-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1597-4613-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1597-4613-4687.notablePrerequisites: Gyre Sage has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-2506-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2466-2506-3249--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding an additional {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

628-3723-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1492-2866-4986-8095.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4986-8095.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

728-2692-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
851-4094-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

943-2203-2597-3861-4235.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
943-2203-2597-3861-4235.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Orzhov Basilica.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-3259-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1741-2232-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
1741-2232-4541-5705.easyPrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1741-2232-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Treasures.
1741-2232-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying its mana cost.
When Cloud of Faeries enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
1741-2232-4541-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

991-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Benthicore, adding {C}{C}.
When Benthicore dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Benthicore from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Benthicore enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-6797-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1824-2530-2932-6709.easyPrerequisites:
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1824-2530-2932-6709.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1636-6844-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Spider-Man 2099 using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
1636-6844-6972.description:
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-6844-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

1648-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1648-4772-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa of Shadowed Boughs
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

104-1874-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1874-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3139-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using The Great Henge's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and gain 2 life.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least six phyresis counters on it

3394-5641-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3394-5641-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2035-4067-5477.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
You control an additional creature.
2035-4067-5477.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gollum, untapping the permanent.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5147-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5147-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2275-3017-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2275-3017-3591-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

997-1445-2267-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-2267-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-4831-4983-5358-5361.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Auton Soldier to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

231-1479-1492.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Plains that enters the battlefield untapped.
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
231-1479-1492.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it, regenerating target artifact.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning any Plains that enters the battlefield untapped to your hand from the battlefield, returning Welding Jar  from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Welding Jar enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting a Plains from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

77-4618-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {2}.
 Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
77-4618-4679.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Instill Energy attached to the mana-producing creature, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate the Instill Energy token by paying {0}, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing the Instill Energy token, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

275-2104-2707.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

382-1409-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Basilica Shepherd.
382-1409-4050.description:
Activate Basilica Shepherd by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Basilica Shepherd enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Basilica Shepherd.
Resolve the Basilica Shepherd trigger, creating two 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mites, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3000-4772-5009.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3000-4772-5009.description:
Activate Ruthless Knave's first ability by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a creature, creating four Treasure tokens and four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Ruthless Knave's second ability.

15-803-1339-4050.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You have a way to draw a card.
15-803-1339-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-2816-4763-5147.description:
Equip Memnite with Umbral Mantle.
Sacrifice Memnite to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Memnite to you hand.
Cast Memnite.
Repeat.

2011-3499-4289.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four other creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
2011-3499-4289.description:
Declare Najeela and four other creatures as attackers, attacking an opponent that is unable to block or kill them.
Najeela triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Najeela and the four untapped attacking creatures by tapping them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
